versionSites.note: top release heading must carry the current package version

forbiddenPatterns.message: em dash (U+2014) is banned; use a hyphen (see CONSTITUTION.md)

this repository is PUBLIC and ships to npm; naming a private repository here publishes the owner's repository inventory. Describe a consumer by role instead. See CONSTITUTION.md, 'What public handoff state and documentation may record'.
internal hostname; this repository is PUBLIC and ships to npm. Write 'a Linux test host' instead. See CONSTITUTION.md, 'What public handoff state and documentation may record'.

a count or posture figure about other repositories (for example 'nine consuming repositories', 'across this estate'); this repository is PUBLIC and ships to npm. State the rule, not the state of the repositories that consume it. See CONSTITUTION.md, 'What public handoff state and documentation may record'.

adopterPaths.reason: Both reviewed mentions are the DESTINATION that `aahp init --gates` writes inside an adopting repository, not a source in this one. The source is assets/governance/aahp-govern.yml. A third mention is how issue #74 happened, so the count is the guard: read the new sentence before raising it.

README Section 7.3 names it as an example of per-agent directory isolation in a non-git workflow. It is a path an adopter would create, and the same section says AAHP tooling does not officially support it.
The second half of the same per-agent isolation example in README Section 7.3.

docs/governance.md names it as the example release-journal target that aahp.config.example.json uses. It is a file in an ADOPTER's tree; this repository has no release journal, and docs/ became a tracked top-level entry here only when the decision log moved into it.

requiredHeadings.note: A new adopter has to find install, init and the first verify run before the specification begins (Section 1), not at 58% depth inside the rationale material (issue #74).

npmDevDependencyUpdates.reason: A lockfile-only update of devDependencies, every entry dev-only, resolved from registry.npmjs.org and integrity-pinned, changes no shipped file and no runtime dependency, so it cannot stale the handoff. The supply-chain-guard job scans it on the pull request.

checks.reason: The 12 files aahp init copies are tracked. git exits non-zero when any one is missing, so the TRUST.md row is re-proven on every verify instead of expiring on a date.
